question: Which customer placed the last order before October 1, 2026? Give the customer name.
sql: SELECT c.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.ordered_on < '2026-10-01' ORDER BY o.ordered_on DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which customer has the highest average order value, and what is that average in euros?
sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(AVG(o.total_eur),2) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

question: How much has the customer from Taipei spent in total, in euros?
sql: SELECT SUM(o.total_eur) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE c.city='Taipei'

question: Which customer has spent the most money in total, and how much?
sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total_eur) t FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was the cheapest order, and who placed it?
sql: SELECT o.item, c.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id ORDER BY o.total_eur ASC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers have never placed an order?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id=c.id)

question: What share of all order revenue came from customers in Lagos? Answer as a percentage.
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.city='Lagos' THEN o.total_eur ELSE 0 END) / SUM(o.total_eur), 1) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id

question: What is the total value of all orders, in euros?
sql: SELECT SUM(total_eur) FROM orders

question: How many days passed between the first order and the last order?
sql: SELECT CAST(julianday(MAX(ordered_on)) - julianday(MIN(ordered_on)) AS INTEGER) FROM orders

question: Which customer's first order was the most expensive first order of all customers? Give the name.
sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id WHERE o.ordered_on=(SELECT MIN(ordered_on) FROM orders WHERE customer_id=c.id) ORDER BY o.total_eur DESC LIMIT 1

question: In which month was the total order revenue highest, and how much was it in euros?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_on) m, SUM(total_eur) FROM orders GROUP BY m ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the most expensive single order, and which customer placed it?
sql: SELECT o.item, o.total_eur, c.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id ORDER BY o.total_eur DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many full weeks passed between Ana Costa's first order and her second order?
sql: SELECT CAST((julianday(MAX(o.ordered_on)) - julianday(MIN(o.ordered_on))) / 7 AS INTEGER) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE c.name='Ana Costa'

question: Which other item was ordered in the same calendar month as the Headset, and by whom?
sql: SELECT o2.item, c.name FROM orders o1 JOIN orders o2 ON strftime('%Y-%m', o1.ordered_on)=strftime('%Y-%m', o2.ordered_on) AND o2.id<>o1.id JOIN customers c ON c.id=o2.customer_id WHERE o1.item='Headset'

question: Which customers have placed only one order? Give their names.
sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id GROUP BY c.id HAVING COUNT(*)=1 ORDER BY c.name

question: Which customer lives in Berlin?
sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE city='Berlin'

question: Which customer placed an order in 2024?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.ordered_on LIKE '2024%'

question: Which customer has a name starting with Z?
sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE name LIKE 'Z%'

question: Which order was worth more than 1,000 euros, and who placed it?
sql: SELECT o.item, c.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.total_eur > 1000

question: Who else placed an order on the same day as Dora Novak?
sql: SELECT c2.name FROM orders o1 JOIN customers c1 ON c1.id=o1.customer_id JOIN orders o2 ON o2.ordered_on=o1.ordered_on AND o2.customer_id<>o1.customer_id JOIN customers c2 ON c2.id=o2.customer_id WHERE c1.name='Dora Novak'
